This phone is then disconnected, and the server data on it is erased.

Your changes could not all be sent to the server. If you delete your account now, they are lost on the server. They are first saved in an automatic backup on this phone, which you can send to yourself.

A copy of what the server stores about you

You get a JSON file with what the server stores about you: your account, your devices, your sessions, your notification registrations and the stock movements you made. Other users’ data is not included.
Your data is ready. Save it or send it to another app.
